Name: Xian Ni - Renegade Immortal - Cultivation and Immortal Magic Overhaul
Author: sushitrash204
Description:
Chinese Translation (简体中文)
A Simplified Chinese translation is available thanks to the community!
[b]Download:[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52067]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52067[/url]
[b]Important:[/b] The translation hasn't been fully updated to support the latest version of the mod, so some newly added text may still appear in English.
To update it, download the latest version of the mod and locate the
[code]ZH_TRANSLATION_KEYS.txt[/code]file included in the archive. This file contains the newly added translation keys. Add these keys to the existing
[code]zh.json[/code]file and translate their values into Chinese.
Special thanks to the translator for making this mod more accessible to Chinese players!


[center][size=6][b]🌌 XIANNI MOD (RENEGADE IMMORTAL)[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Complete Eastern Cultivation (Xianxia) Total Overhaul[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

A massive, feature-complete Eastern Cultivation (Xianxia) total overhaul for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b], faithfully adapted from the legendary novel [b]"Renegade Immortal"[/b] by [b]Er Gen[/b].

Step onto the path of defying the heavens: cultivate through 17 grand realms, overcome deadly Heavenly Tribulations, temper the ancient physique of an 8-million HP Ancient God Titan, command an army of autonomous Shadow Clones, soar across the skies on Flying Swords, and cast cataclysmic Divine Spells!

[line]

[size=5][b]⚡ CORE FEATURES AT A GLANCE[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. 📿 17 Cultivation Realms & 70 Sub-Realms[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]From Mortal to Sovereign:[/b] Advance through [b]70 distinct stages[/b] across 17 Grand Realms:
[list]
[*][i]First Step:[/i] Qi Condensation (Layers 1-15), Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, Soul Transformation, Soul Formation, Ascendant, Yin Void, Yang Corporeal.[/*]
[*][i]Second Step (Nirvana):[/i] Nirvana Scryer, Nirvana Cleanser, Nirvana Shatterer.[/*]
[*][i]Third Step (Void):[/i] Void Nirvana, Void Spirit, Void Arcane, Void Tribulation.[/*]
[*][i]Fourth Step:[/i] [b]Heaven Trampling Realm (Ultimate Sovereign)[/b].[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Breakthrough Quests:[/b] Each major breakthrough requires dynamic in-game accomplishments (Help Wanted bulletin board quests, Mine Floor 120, Museum artifact donations, Ginger Island Golden Walnuts, Volcano Forge mastery, Qi's Secret Room, Farm Obelisks, and 100% True Perfection).[/*]
[*][b]Heavenly Tribulation System:[/b] Major breakthroughs trigger apocalyptic lightning calamity trials with 16 unique Divine Tribulation Bosses, falling thunder strikes, and custom boss health bars.[/*]
[*][b]Meditation (Key [J]):[/b] Sit in deep meditative seclusion with custom sitting animations and glowing auras to regenerate vital energy and reduce realm upgrade gold costs by 20g per second (can achieve 100% free breakthroughs through patient meditation).[/*]
[*][b]Realm Suppression:[/b] Slay lower-realm foes with massive exponential damage multipliers (6x, 25x, 80x, up to 15,000x+) while higher-realm monsters possess divine protective barriers.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]2. ☯️ Dual Body System (Key [H])[/b][/size]
Seamlessly switch between two completely independent cultivation vessels:
[list]
[*][b]Daoist Body:[/b] Masters flying swords, celestial spells, barrier manipulation, and spiritual meditation.[/*]
[*][b]Ancient God Body:[/b]
[list]
[*]Temper your mortal flesh from [b]1-Star to 9-Star Ancient God[/b] by absorbing the refined essence of Ores, Metal Bars, and Precious Gems via the Shipping Bin.[/*]
[*]Unlocks colossal Titan HP (up to 8,000,000+ Max Health), innate 8% lifesteal, physical immunity, and unyielding defense.[/*]
[*][b]Independent Profiles:[/b] Each body saves its own health, equipment, inventory, and Fashion Sense cosmetics separately![/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]3. 👥 5 Autonomous Shadow Clones (Key [O])[/b][/size]
Summon 5 fully autonomous AI clones that intelligently navigate your farm and world:
[list]
[*][b]Farming Clone:[/b] Automatically tills soil, waters crops, harvests ripe produce, and clears withered crops.[/*]
[*][b]Ranching Clone:[/b] Pets barn/coop animals, refills hay hoppers, feeds livestock, and gathers animal products/truffles.[/*]
[*][b]Mining Clone:[/b] Delves into mine floors, breaks rocks, mines ores/gems, and slays underground monsters.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing Clone:[/b] Visits water bodies, fishes autonomously, catches high-quality fish, and hauls treasure chests.[/*]
[*][b]Foraging / Patrol Clone:[/b] Cleans weeds/debris, harvests wild plants, and patrols territory.[/*]
[*][b]Progression System:[/b] Clones earn individual EXP, level up from [b]Lv. 1 to 100[/b], and possess their own internal inventories that you can inspect and claim anytime.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]4. 🗡️ 4 Ancient Relics & Flying Treasures[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Flying Sword:[/b] Hold and Left-Click to mount and fly freely over rivers, cliffs, and obstacles. Automatically unleashes homing sword beams at nearby foes and shatters rocks upon landing. Melee damage dynamically scales with your cultivation realm.[/*]
[*][b]One-Billion Soul Banner:[/b] Siphons monster souls upon defeat (stores up to 25 specters). Ghosts automatically swarm and bite enemies. [b]Right-Click[/b] to trigger [b]Soul Detonation[/b] for massive screen-wide explosions.[/*]
[*][b]Heaven Defying Bead:[/b] Hold and Left-Click to deploy the ancient spatial domain. Continuously regenerates HP and Stamina, doubles meditation gain, and exerts overwhelming divine pressure that repels monsters within 5 tiles.[/*]
[*][b]God-Slaying Spear:[/b] Flying spear relic of the Ancient God Clan. Fly at double speed, pierce directly through enemy realm barriers, and unleash devastating physical strikes.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]5. 🔮 11 Cataclysmic Divine Spells (Key [K])[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Zhan Luo Slash:[/b] Sweeping golden crescent blade wave that cuts through terrain and executes foes below 25% HP.[/*]
[*][b]Body Freeze:[/b] Imposes celestial stillness, freezing all monsters and projectiles within range in place.[/*]
[*][b]Wind Calling:[/b] Summons raging dark cyclones that pull enemies in and shred them.[/*]
[*][b]Soul Transformation Palm:[/b] A colossal divine palm descending from heaven, leaving an impact crater with massive physical knockback.[/*]
[*][b]Extreme Realm:[/b] Instant red celestial lightning that annihilates targets.[/*]
[*][b]Killing Intent Dragon:[/b] Stacks killing intent into a protective barrier and summons the devastating [b]Killing Black Dragon[/b] with custom dragon roars![/*]
[*][b]Ancient God Avatar:[/b] Manifests the colossal Ancient God form for crushing shockwaves and heavy lifesteal.[/*]
[*][b]Dream Dao:[/b] Summons azure dream butterflies to put monsters into deep slumber before shattering their dream for burst damage.[/*]
[*][b]Dawn Break:[/b] [i]«Tearing the night sky, scooping the moon from the water»[/i] — Summons a rising celestial sun that turns night into day, unleashing screen-wide continuous slashes.[/*]
[*][b]Domain of Life & Death:[/b] Summons the Wheel of Samsara, transmuting dealt damage into permanent Max HP increases![/*]
[*][b]Spatial Shift (Key [U]):[/b] Instant spatial teleportation to any saved map, NPC, or coordinates.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]6. 🛠️ Quality of Life & Divine Utilities[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]3-Page Extended Backpack (Keys [ [ ] and [ ] ]):[/b] Expands inventory up to [b]108 slots[/b] with built-in page navigation buttons on the inventory screen.[/*]
[*][b]Bagua Touch / Shortcut HUD:[/b] On-screen interactive Bagua wheel button for instant access to spells, meditation, clone menus, and body switching (ideal for controllers & mobile players).[/*]
[*][b]Divine Sense (Key [P]):[/b] Overlays real-time realm badges, monster bloodline tiers ([i]Low, Mid, High, Supreme, Divine Beast[/i]), and HP bars.[/*]
[*][b]Divine Auto-Harvest (Key [L]):[/b] Divine area harvesting, auto-tilling, watering, and mining with stamina discounts based on your realm.[/*]
[*][b]Sword Spirit Hua Li Guo (Key [i]):[/i][/b][i] Summons the eccentric evil spirit Hua Li Guo as your comedic talking companion.
[/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Inner Demon Trial:[/b] Face an exact mirror boss clone of your own build and spells.[/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Immersive Xianxia BGM:[/b] Built-in traditional Guzheng/Erhu soundtrack player with loop/repeat/skip options.[/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Full GMCM & Localization:[/b] Fully translated into [b]100% English & Vietnamese[/b]; all keybindings, rates, and costs are customizable in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/i]
[/*]
[/list][*]
[line]
